title: Premium Billing Accounts: The Orthodontic Rider Credit Calculation
content:
The rider credit on Premium Billing Accounts is the monthly amount multiplied by the rider months counted, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure. The monthly amount is the rider premium; the rider months counted are the rider months billed after the rider's end.

**The ended rider** is the Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider funded by the account whose status is terminated; where more than one is on record, the one with the latest termination date (of two with the same date, the one recorded first). Its **rider premium** is the rider plan's monthly premium per covered person. Where the account funds no ended orthodontic rider, the rider credit is 0.00.

**Rider months billed after its end** are the whole calendar months from the month after the month of the rider's termination date through the last coverage month of the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first), that last month being the invoice's coverage month advanced by its months covered less one. They are zero when no invoice or no ended rider is on record, or when that last month is not later than the termination month.

**Posting.** The credit is posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last.

| Rider's termination month | Invoice issued last | Last coverage month | Rider months billed after its end |
|---|---|---|---|
| April | coverage month June, 1 month | June | May, June: 2 |
| April | coverage month April, 3 months | June | 2 |
| April | coverage month January, 3 months | March | 0 (not later than April) |
| April | coverage month May, 12 months | April of the next year | 12 |

**Worked example (hypothetical).** Rider premium 27.35; termination 30 April; invoice issued last covers 3 months from June, so through August. Rider months billed after its end: May through August, 4. Credit: 27.35 multiplied by 4, 109.40, posted against June.
